info.title: Zigpaw · Clinical
info.description: The canonical Zigpaw API used by private browser façades, the future iOS application, and explicitly approved service clients. Browser façades are same-origin adapters and are not separate public APIs.

clinical_access.const: Clinical records remain limited to explicit, profile-manager-approved grants.

zigpawOAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE. Browser tokens remain in the portal BFF; native clients store them in the platform secure keychain.

scopes.consumer:read: Read the signed-in customer account and its authorized pet data.
scopes.consumer:write: Update the signed-in customer account and its authorized pet data.
scopes.clinical:read: Read the authenticated clinical portal identity.
scopes.clinical:submit: Submit pending records through an explicit provider grant.
scopes.business:read: Read the active business organization and its authorized providers.
scopes.business:profile:write: Update the active business organization profile.
scopes.business:providers:read: Read providers and locations managed by the active organization.
scopes.business:providers:write: Claim and manage provider and location records.
scopes.business:bookings:read: Read booking requests managed by the active organization.
scopes.business:bookings:write: Respond to and manage booking requests.
scopes.business:programs:read: Read commercial and partner-program enrollment status.
scopes.business:programs:write: Apply for or manage commercial program enrollment.
scopes.business:financials:read: Read authorized commission accruals and commercial agreements.
scopes.business:team:write: Invite and manage organization team members.
